note: Windows 10 20H1 (19041) / 20H2 (19042) / 21H1 (19043) / 21H2 (19044). This chunk ships the schema stub with null offsets — authoritative EPROCESS offsets for these builds were not reachable from the chunk's environment (no trusted pdbex/vergilius dump on hand). Operators populate with pdbex output before relying on the fast-path; the loader skips null-valued entries and falls back to the live PDB (and then the InvariantFieldFinder). Only the DISPATCHER_HEADER assertion is verified from first principles (KOBJECTS::ProcessObject == 0x03 on every x64 build since Vista).
